answer: Pay weather agents once per station and time slot. A report of a gale above a mesa or a meadow must include the station's signed sample; the market deduplicates by station ID and timestamp. Ten thousand aliases replaying that sample earn one payment. Buyers escrow a fixed budget per job, so clones cannot manufacture new rewards by trading with each other. This depends on scarce station credentials: if an attacker can certify imaginary stations, the cap fails.
